short_title: SAM2 causal memory surgery as validated decomposition instrument
dissent_recorded: MED: entire program is natural video; medical video (echo/endoscopy/surgical) is where SAM2 memory failure is clinically load-bearing and is absent
strongest_remaining_claim: Reversible fraction under oracle-timed targeted deletion is a validated decomposition instrument: it must beat full reset by >=10 pts (pre-error memories load-bearing) AND predict per-sequence gains of independent training-free prevention methods
why_top_venue_accepts: Subfield produced ~8 competing memory policies with no common headroom yardstick; arXiv:2512.22624 states progress is 'bottlenecked by memory design'; SAM2RL observes hand-crafted policies leave performance on the table and even RL-overfit policies hit a memory-capacity limit
hidden_upside: (1) SAM2RL gives an independent NON-ORACLE ceiling for cross-validation, neutralising the oracle attack empirically; (2) SAM3's more conservative memory policy turns the diagnostic into a GENERATIONAL headroom law and the SAM3 tracking zoo is public; (3) comparator pool for the predictive-validity leg grew from 2 to 6+ training-free methods at near-zero marginal cost
key_new_literature_this_session: arXiv:2512.22624 (SAM3 memory transfer study + SAM3_Tracking_Zoo); arXiv:2606.24449 SENTRY; arXiv:2507.08548 SAM2RL; AS-SAM2 TCSVT 2026
quiet_killer: P1 (deletion recovers a lot) is now near-consensus across >=6 papers, so novelty narrows onto P2 and P3; SAM3's conservative retention may already shrink the memory-borne share; 'systematic memory-centric study' framing real estate is now occupied
top_unresolved_disagreement: FM vs SEG: whether the SAM3 arm must be core (FM: a SAM2.1-only paper reads retrospective) or an extension (SEG: doubles harvest cost, dilutes one decisive decomposition into a two-model survey)
mandatory_design_delta: SAM3 arm in core; comparator set >=4 with a PREREGISTERED COMBINED validity statistic (min r across a named set) not per-method selection; label the ceiling 'oracle-timed' throughout; promote t_r +/- delta dose-response to a main result; add SAM2RL cross-ceiling comparison

dissent_recorded: FM will not advance without re-centring the method panel on training-free foundation matchers; MED wants the medical one-shot arm promoted from generalization to core
strongest_remaining_claim: Support-independent share of FSS accuracy per method x benchmark x query-complexity stratum against a support-free objectness floor, with distractor-present stratum preregistered as primary; headline statistic is a WITHIN-METHOD RATIO and therefore immune to the absolute-number irreproducibility now documented in this literature
why_top_venue_accepts: No counterfactual audit exists despite a large mitigation literature that presumes support quality matters; and an unrelated group just showed FSS numbers can be silently distorted by >37 points via preprocessing-space mismatch, so the field is primed for a one-harness re-run + support-sensitivity score + fixed distractor-enriched split
hidden_upside: (1) The preprocessing/eval-space confound becomes a SECOND FREE HEADLINE since every checkpoint is re-run anyway; (2) Open-V independently reports support contribution rises as text priors weaken - partial corroboration of the mechanism from the opposite direction; (3) SAM3-PCS and frozen-DINOv3 matchers give a far harder support-free floor, providing a second independent route to the same conclusion
key_new_literature_this_session: arXiv:2606.09474 Open-V (37-point preprocessing confound; +17.7 HM training-free on PASCAL-5i); arXiv:2401.11311 FSS benchmark in the foundation-model era; arXiv:2501.13529 support dilution; arXiv:2607.24706 SADe
quiet_killer: Significance decay worsened since Stage 4: the specialist leaderboard (PFENet/HSNet/BAM) being reordered is actively obsolescing; re-centring on foundation matchers shifts the expected answer toward LOW retention i.e. the certification branch, the least headline-dense outcome; FSS-1000 degenerate and PASCAL-5i mostly single-object, so only COCO-20i/LVIS-92i distractor strata carry the claim
top_unresolved_disagreement: METH vs FM: is the certification branch (all methods collapse appropriately) top-venue publishable? METH yes - first counterfactual audit of a field's core claim plus a standing artifact. FM no - a null audit of an obsolescing subfield is a workshop paper
mandatory_design_delta: Re-centre the method panel so training-free foundation matchers incl. a SAM3-PCS floor are PRIMARY and specialists are the historical arm; promote the dual-evaluator protocol (one shared + each repo's native) from robustness to primary

dissent_recorded: FM: the decoders in the table are the 2023-24 generation; SAM3-class concept decoders are where the field is, and fine-mask training data may make 'training-limited' a foregone conclusion
strongest_remaining_claim: The cutoff-to-oracle ratio table: empirical contour-frequency error cutoff divided by an oracle grid-resampling reference with no model in the loop, across >=4 architectures x >=3 output resolutions, against exact analytic synthetic ground truth. Ratio ~1 = sampling-limited (resolution is a real dial); ratio << 1 = training-limited (resolution increases wasted)
why_top_venue_accepts: Cheapest decisive experiment in the whole portfolio; both outcomes redirect real engineering budgets; and the frequency-aliasing literature that exists is entirely ENCODER-side (feature-map downsampling in semantic-segmentation CNNs) - nobody measures output-side contour bandwidth of a promptable mask decoder against its own sampling bound
hidden_upside: LARGEST UPSIDE FOUND THIS SESSION: arXiv:2012.14123 reports cross-entropy, IoU AND Boundary-IoU are all dominated by LOW-frequency components of segmentation maps - a loss-side mechanism predicting exactly the training-limited world, upgrading A-0061 from a datasheet to a mechanism paper testable via a boundary-weighted-loss comparison arm. Plus precedent that analytically-derived frequency thresholds convert into real gains (DAF: UPerNet-R50 78.1->79.3 mIoU, beating AdaBlur 78.9), and the oracle grid-resampling baseline is a reusable model-free instrument
key_new_literature_this_session: arXiv:2012.14123 Spectral Analysis for Semantic Segmentation; arXiv:2403.09065 When Semantic Segmentation Meets Frequency Aliasing; AAAI 2026 10.1609/aaai.v40i9.37713; arXiv:2306.01567 HQ-SAM
quiet_killer: HQ-SAM's own published DIS mBIoU 52.8->70.4 from a high-res token/feature path is prima facie evidence that the output feature path DOES bind - i.e. evidence for the sampling-limited world and AGAINST the expected 'resolution is wasted' headline. Stage 5 did not note this tension. Also: adjacency density in the aliasing literature; if the empirical cutoff simply equals the analytic Nyquist, Stage-4 attack #1 returns empirically; knee identifiability is a live risk
top_unresolved_disagreement: METH vs FM on the HQ-SAM tension: METH calls a genuinely two-sided experiment the point; FM calls a 'HQ-SAM was right' headline a materially smaller paper
mandatory_design_delta: Freeze the contour-frequency convention in preregistration and report BOTH arc-length and image-plane conventions; add the X3 loss-frequency prediction as an explicit hypothesis with a boundary-weighted-loss comparison arm; add one medical fine-structure arm (vessel or lesion margin)

short_title: Blending-artifact detectability to synthetic-to-real transfer-gap ladder
dissent_recorded: FM: domain-specific measurement paper, mechanism is a special case of documented shortcut learning, 20-50x the compute of A-0061 in a crowded fast-moving lane. SEG withholds ADVANCE pending the label-jitter control arm
strongest_remaining_claim: At FIXED generator and FIXED content, compositing-artifact detectability (boundary-patch probe AUROC) orders real-set DSC of segmenters trained on the composites, AND re-injecting the measured seam residual into the best-blended arm reopens >=50% of the real-DSC spread. Forward leg = ordering; reverse leg = the artifact is USED not merely present
why_top_venue_accepts: Only design in the slate that answers both Stage-4 attacks structurally rather than argumentatively; fully public stack (SyntheticTumors, DiffTumor, libcom); the deliverable (report your pipeline's probe AUROC) is adoptable immediately
hidden_upside: (1) Strong current venue appetite: SADGE claims no prior study evaluates which similarity metric best predicts downstream utility (r=0.879 dataset-level, correlational), and an EO benchmark shows FID and human realism both FAIL to track utility - so a cheap head-to-head arm against FID/DINOv3/SADGE-style metrics on the same fixed-content ladder is nearly free and very attractive; (2) the 2026 fix wave (SRA-Seg soft edge blending; Texture-Shape Dilemma's formal 'boundary aliasing' + gradient-shielded buffer) is uncontrolled partial evidence the law exists and shows practitioners already pay a design cost with no measured dose-response; (3) the Texture-Shape Dilemma's 56%->40% collapse from naive high-frequency texture injection is an artifact-injection precedent for the reverse leg
key_new_literature_this_session: arXiv:2605.22467 SADGE; arXiv:2606.25128 EO data-quality benchmarking; arXiv:2602.02944 SRA-Seg; arXiv:2603.00985 Texture-Shape Dilemma; arXiv:2511.18654 tumor fabrication
quiet_killer: The fix wave that demoted B-0222 applies here: soft/harmonized blending may be default by publication, making hard cut-paste a straw arm. SADGE's finding that only the nonlinear appearance-geometry interplay predicts transfer caps the single-axis probe to the fixed-content regime, narrowing the hygiene-metric deliverable. MISSING CONTROL: no arm perturbs the LABEL boundary at fixed image, so 'keys on the seam' is not fully separated from 'keys on a label-boundary regularity co-varying with the seam'. Highest training cost in the slate after C-0090
top_unresolved_disagreement: MED vs FM: is the probe a hygiene metric or an ablation? MED - a pipeline IS fixed content, so a fixed-content-valid probe is exactly right. FM - a metric requiring you to already control the generator is not a hygiene check. This decides whether the most adoptable deliverable survives
mandatory_design_delta: Add the label-jitter control arm (perturb mask boundary, hold image fixed); add head-to-head vs FID / DINOv3-similarity / SADGE-style fused metric on the same ladder; report ladder SLOPE with CIs as primary rather than Spearman rho alone; strike 'law' from the framing

short_title: Text-batch rehearsal works by gradient rebalancing not content
dissent_recorded: FM DISSENTS from the panel vote: only Top-5 idea on a frontier model class, only training-mechanism study in the slate; dropping it leaves a Final 3 of purely inference-only diagnostics
strongest_remaining_claim: The content-free rehearsal grid: at fixed token budget under preregistered gradient-matching conventions, how much of curated rehearsal's capability-stratified retention survives progressive content destruction (curated -> random web -> token-shuffled -> single repeated doc). The A3/A4 arms dissecting diversity vs lexical statistics vs syntax are the real contribution
why_top_venue_accepts: A direct controlled intervention on a question the field is arguing about in print, with all three outcome branches changing a training recipe
hidden_upside: (1) It is now the DECISIVE EXPERIMENT FOR A NAMED LIVE DISPUTE, not a folklore test: arXiv:2603.14493 argues forgetting is overstated and that TASK DIVERSITY specifically (not volume) is operative - an observational content-side claim with no content-free control and no gradient matching, which is exactly what C-0090 supplies; (2) modality gradient conflict now has a formal definition (arXiv:2512.03125 Def.1) and measurement (Pareto LoRA: gradients differ by orders of magnitude ACROSS LAYERS), which tells us per-layer matching should be the preregistered PRIMARY convention rather than symmetric with global-norm; (3) a positive result deletes a recurring data-curation cost line
key_new_literature_this_session: arXiv:2603.14493 Fine-tuning MLLMs Without Forgetting Is Easier Than You Think; arXiv:2512.03125 MoDE; arXiv:2606.17296 Pareto LoRA; NAACL 2025.naacl-long.222 BALGRAD; 2026.findings-acl.1210 representation mixing; PMLR v330 srivastava26a
quiet_killer: POWER IS THE TOP RISK AND IT WORSENED: if forgetting is largely avoidable by regularization/low LR, the A1-A0 denominator may be small - which is exactly C-0090's own abort gate, and it fires after ~1000 A100-h. The mushy middle is now the PREDICTED outcome rather than a risk, since diversity effects imply A4<A2<A1. Cost 2450 A100-h is ~10x the entire recommended Final 3. LLaVA-1.5-7B is an old base for 2026. Mechanism lane is saturated with claimants
top_unresolved_disagreement: FM (ADVANCE, dissenting) vs MED (DROP): whether a POSSIBLE mechanism result on a frontier model class outweighs a CERTAIN audit result at 250x the GPU cost, in a portfolio whose declared domain is segmentation and medical imaging. Also METH: the 80%-of-curated-effect rule is a ratio of differences unstable at small denominators, and 'divergence across conventions IS the finding' is unfalsifiable-adjacent
mandatory_design_delta: If revived: preregister a MINIMUM DETECTABLE A1-A0 gap evaluated BEFORE the 15 arms (not after 6) and leave the ratio uninterpreted below it; designate per-layer matching as the single primary convention
promote_alternate_if_dropped: M5/B-0362 (gated on desk survey); fallback A-0178

short_title: Artifact tokens cause prompt-localized failures via test-time register toggle
strongest_remaining_claim: On artifact-positive promptable encoders, on-artifact click failure exceeds matched off-artifact failure, and the excess collapses under a test-time register toggle at identical pixels while a sham toggle leaves it intact
why_top_venue_accepts: Rare clean causal instrument bridging interpretability to user-visible product failure, with a 1-GPU-hour existential gate whose empty outcome is itself a publishable scope note
hidden_upside: Instrument confirmed live and demonstrably unapplied to SAM-family encoders: test-time registers is NeurIPS 2025 and has been extended to VLMs and DiTs, and arXiv:2605.05206 reports the outlier phenomenon is 'substantially more severe' in SigLIP2 with no trained registers available. That paper also reports masking high-norm tokens does NOT help - implicating corrupted local patch semantics rather than extreme values, which sharpens A-0178's mechanism and makes the register toggle the principled instrument rather than an arbitrary one
key_new_literature_this_session: arXiv:2506.08010 Vision Transformers Don't Need Trained Registers (NeurIPS 2025); arXiv:2605.05206 Taming Outlier Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
quiet_killer: The existential gate remains: SAM's MAE lineage may show weak-to-no artifacts, voiding the flagship arm on day 1
top_unresolved_disagreement: SEG/MED hold that a fleet audit returning empty is a scope note, not a paper; FM/METH hold that at 1 GPU-hour the option value is unambiguous
mandatory_design_delta: Run the fleet norm audit as a standalone rider regardless of slot allocation
